title: Director of Product Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: As a printer manufacturer serving the signage and graphics industry, Epson's Product Marketing leadership is critical because they define the complete solution story that their customers (sign shops, wrap installers, graphics companies) present to end users. This role owns competitive differentiation and solution positioning for the SureColor product lines. By partnering with Tedlar, they can enhance their value proposition with a proven protective film solution that extends the outdoor lifespan of prints to 12-20+ years—directly addressing end-customer concerns about durability, UV resistance, and warranty claims. This role benefits from: (1) Stronger competitive positioning against Roland, HP, and Mimaki by offering a complete, premium durability solution; (2) Reduced customer complaints about print degradation by recommending Tedlar overlaminates in their application guides; (3) Enhanced customer success stories demonstrating superior ROI through reduced replacement cycles; (4) Co-marketing opportunities at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United where Epson maintains major presence. Given Epson's recent SureColor S9170 launch and continuous product innovation, Product Marketing needs premium material partnerships to differentiate their solutions in the outdoor signage, vehicle wrap, and architectural graphics segments where durability is the primary customer concern.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This role owns the go-to-market strategy, messaging, and competitive positioning for Epson's SureColor large-format printer lines. They define how Epson's solutions are packaged and presented to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and graphics companies. They likely report to VP of Marketing or Chief Marketing Officer and collaborate closely with Product Management, Sales, and Business Development teams. This person influences (but doesn't directly control) technical specifications and application guides, but owns the narrative about why customers should choose Epson over Roland, HP, or Mimaki. Their decisions shape customer-facing materials, training programs, trade show messaging, and solution positioning across the outdoor signage, vehicle wrap, and architectural graphics segments.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For this role specifically, Tedlar's most relevant applications are those that strengthen Epson's complete solution story to their direct customers (sign shops and wrap installers): (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics protection—where Tedlar's graffiti resistance and extreme weather performance address the warranty concerns that plague wrap installers using Epson SureColor R-Series and S-Series printers; (2) Outdoor signage and banner protection—where Tedlar's outdoor lifespan allows sign manufacturers to offer extended warranties on prints produced with Epson equipment, creating competitive advantage in municipal and commercial bids; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps—where Tedlar's UV protection prevents the fading and degradation that damages Epson's reputation when prints fail prematurely in high-visibility installations. This role benefits by having a validated protective film partner they can reference in case studies, application guides, and competitive sales tools that prove Epson+Tedlar combinations outperform alternative printer-laminate pairings in real-world outdoor conditions.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This person likely owns metrics around competitive win rates, customer satisfaction scores, solution adoption rates, and market positioning perception versus competitors like Roland and HP. They personally care about reducing customer complaints regarding print degradation and warranty claims, because these issues undermine Epson's premium brand positioning and make competitive differentiation harder. Their success depends on creating compelling narratives that help Epson's sales team win deals and help Epson's customers win their deals with end users. Tedlar solves a specific pain point for them: currently, when an Epson customer produces an outdoor graphic that fails due to UV damage or weather degradation, it reflects poorly on the entire Epson solution—even though the printer and ink performed correctly. By partnering with Tedlar, Product Marketing can shift the conversation from 'our prints last 3-5 years' to 'Epson-printed graphics protected with Tedlar deliver proven outdoor performance'—a far stronger competitive message for premium outdoor applications where municipalities and fleet operators demand extended durability guarantees.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Epson is exhibiting at ISA Sign Expo 2026 and recently launched the SureColor S9170 solvent printer at PRINTING United 2024, indicating active product innovation cycles and major trade show presence. These events represent natural timing hooks for partnership discussions—either preparing differentiated messaging for ISA 2026 or building case studies around the new S9170 launch. Additionally, Epson won three PRINTING United Alliance 2024 Pinnacle Product Awards, suggesting heightened market visibility and opportunity to capitalize on industry recognition with complementary solution partnerships. The company's emphasis on same-day lamination capability and immediate scratch resistance in their marketing materials indicates they are already positioning around protection and durability themes—making this an opportune time to introduce a premium protective film partner that substantiates these claims.

personalization_hooks.hook: Epson markets same-day lamination and scratch resistance for vehicle wraps, but lacks a validated protective film partner to substantiate these durability claims in competitive comparisons against Roland and HP
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging their strong positioning around immediate protection and fast turnaround, then introduce Tedlar as the missing piece that transforms 'scratch resistant' into 'graffiti-proof with proven outdoor performance'—giving them concrete competitive ammunition for premium outdoor graphics bids where end customers demand performance guarantees

personalization_hooks.hook: As Director of Product Marketing for a printer manufacturer, they face the challenge that print failures due to inadequate protection damage Epson's brand reputation even when the printer and ink performed correctly
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar partnership as a brand protection strategy—by recommending proven protective films in application guides and case studies, they help customers avoid the UV degradation and weather damage that leads to warranty claims and reflects poorly on the entire Epson solution, while positioning Epson as a complete solution provider rather than just equipment seller

personalization_hooks.hook: Epson maintains major presence at ISA Sign Expo (2024, 2025, 2026) and PRINTING United, where sign shops and wrap installers are actively seeking complete workflows from substrate to protection
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their upcoming ISA Sign Expo 2026 participation and suggest exploring co-marketing opportunities—joint booth demonstrations, case studies, or application guides showing Epson+Tedlar combinations outperforming competitive solutions in outdoor durability tests, giving their sales team concrete proof points for premium installations

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation angle—frame Tedlar as the strategic partner that helps Epson's Product Marketing team tell a complete solution story that wins deals against Roland, HP, and Mimaki in premium outdoor graphics segments. Emphasize that this is about strengthening their go-to-market positioning and customer success metrics, not selling them film. Mention their ISA Sign Expo presence as a natural timing hook for exploring partnership conversations.
